Chapter 1190 - 11 Chaos Taiji (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1190: Chapter 11 Chaos Taiji (Seeking Subscription)

"Wonderful!"

Lin Yuan rapidly absorbed the inheritance content, many previously confusing aspects began to ’melt away’ at this moment.

The creator of this inheritance was a Peak Venerable from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, countless ages ago.

This Peak Venerable’s father was of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s royal family.

And the mother was a cultivator from the Xuanyin Ancient Country.

The Fierce Sun Ancient Country and the Xuanyin Ancient Country stem from two supreme ancestors, representing entirely opposite paths.

Yet bloodline inheritance is wondrous, capable of integrating all.

After the union of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s royal and the cultivator from Xuanyin Ancient Country, the creator of the inheritance was born with both Fierce Sun and Xuanyin bloodlines.

Initially, the inheritance creator grew up in the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

So, naturally, the early influences were all related to Fierce Sun, with a primary focus on the Fierce Sun path.

As for the Xuanyin essence deep within the bloodline? It wasn’t given much attention.

But as the strength increased and the realm advanced, the path of Chaos Intense Sun was realized, cultivating to the third level...

The inheritance creator vaguely sensed that perhaps Fierce Sun and Xuanyin were not oppositional.

Since all originates from chaos, where is the opposition?

"Fierce Sun? Xuanyin? If one could thoroughly merge them, it feels like it would be a brand new path that surpasses all known paths. Alas, my comprehension is insufficient; I cannot achieve perfect fusion."

Within the inheritance content Lin Yuan absorbed, images emerged, including the last recorded message from this inheritance creator—

"If I could reach the ancestor’s realm, with such a magnificent life’s perspective, I should be able to merge Fierce Sun and Xuanyin. So next, I will attempt to break through to the final step."

...

Lin Yuan roughly browsed the entire inheritance; this inheritance concluded with the creator preparing to attempt the thirteenth level breakthrough.

"Probably didn’t succeed."

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, in this source world, the Xuanyin Ancient Country was the last to emerge, and to this day, there has been no mention of a seventh ancient country.

If a new thirteenth-level ancestor had emerged, a seventh ancient country would certainly have been established.

The absence of a seventh ancient country indicates that the creator did not enter the thirteenth level.

"Thirteenth level..." Lin Yuan sighed inwardly.

Whether it is the Chaos Void or this source world, the ultimate goal of all cultivators is to enter the thirteenth level, becoming a time life.

Only those at the thirteenth level, capable of perceiving numerous timelines of past and future, can attain freedom in a broad sense.

As for beings below the thirteenth level? Their vision is confined to space, unable to see the distant future, unclear of what will happen next, like a lone boat on the vast sea, unaware of when it might capsize.

From the perspective of time, all beings below the thirteenth level are blind, groping in the dark, while thirteenth-level beings possess vision, allowing them to see their surroundings, be it danger or opportunity.

...

"This inheritance has greatly helped me, it was worth it."

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts, having to admit, the cultivators of this source world surpass the Chaos Void by a significant margin in comprehending the path of rules.

The absolute Great Saints of the Chaos Void are only at the second level of evolving the Chaos Power path. Their ability to rival the Peak Venerables of this Fang Yuan World’s third-level path is entirely due to the advantage of their internal cosmos.

In fact, many cultivators of the six ancient countries have attempted to develop internal worlds, internal universes. Once their mastery of the rules reaches a certain level, creating a world or universe is not difficult.

But without the infusion of Chaos Void Origin, even if they successfully create internal worlds or universes, they can’t develop them to a level that provides significant support.

It was not until now that Lin Yuan realized just how crucial the Chaos Void’s ’exclusive’ cosmic origin infusion is, directly making the foundation of all Chaos Void cultivators much stronger.

Of course, this source world also has advantages over the Chaos Void, notably the ease of comprehending rules.

Why could Peak Venerables of the six ancient countries cultivate the chaotic evolution path to the third level? Surpassing the Chaos Void’s absolute Great Saints?

Naturally, it is due to the exaggerated degree of rule comprehension in the source world.

...

"Still over two hundred thousand merits..."

Lin Yuan glanced at his merit ’balance’, having spent one million eight hundred thousand merits to exchange for this inheritance.

"Exchange the remaining merits for Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams."

Lin Yuan surveyed the various precious inheritances he valued and found that two hundred thousand merits were not enough, so he planned to exchange for more Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams.

The Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams were created with a lofty view by the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, using the viewpoint of a thirteenth-level time life to revert and regroup the chaos rules that evolve all things.

Among them, the Mystic Pattern Diagrams representing the Chaos Third Realm contain a total of fifty-four diagrams, each costing one hundred thousand merits. Lin Yuan had previously exchanged for one, and now with two hundred thousand merits left, he planned to exchange for two more to study.

Exchanging for Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams is never a loss; these diagrams, symbolizing the fundamental chaos rules, will make it infinitely easier for Lin Yuan to comprehend rules.

...

On the way back to his residence, Lin Yuan remembered the information the emperor had disclosed.

The Fierce Sun Ancient Country had acquired a billion-year guardian right over a first-grade treasured land, the ’Infinite Eye’, from the Xuanyin Ancient Country.

"Infinite Eye..." Information about this treasured land flashed through Lin Yuan’s mind.

This treasure, seen from the outside, resembles a gigantic eye, and its peculiar produced treasures are Infinite Crystals.
